assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the subject's single curated REVIEWED item at basis_commit, read in full with its front matter: the canonical V2 Phase 3 specialist synthesis series/monogatari-series/V2 Analysis/04 Specialist Synthesis/05_SENJOUGAHARA_HITAGI_WEIGHT_SPEECH_LOVE_AND_HOUSEHOLD.md (D05), the project's literary analysis of the locked Japanese numbered corpus V01-V30 plus the controlled supplementary admissions Hyakumonogatari (SUP-C, HYAKU-) and Mijikanamonogatari (SUP-A, SHORT-), chronology boundary C764. The ledgers, deep readings and later specialist syntheses it names (including D12 relationships, D13 family and names, D18 language and the full-series synthesis) are not curated on this subject and were not used; locators cited below are D05's own volume, arc and section citations, and no claim rests on unread linked material. D05's reconstruction seed (section 26) is labeled a seed for a D25 profile that does not exist at basis; that label and the project's own phase labels are not adopted as readiness. The corpus map was consulted for context only. No primary-source inspection was performed.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Hitagi from the pre-crab prehistory D05 draws from HYAKU-005, HYAKU-079 and SHORT-017 (prior awareness of Araragi, social and athletic prominence, both partly interested-witness evidence) through V01 (crab case, chosen reburdening, confession, see/unsee promise), V02-V06 (Kanbaru nonreciprocity, truth obligation, V03 date and sexual boundary, V05 Kaiki pressure, Araragi confinement and the present-self assertion, V06 growth), V08 (Hanekawa-narrated friendship), V11 and V13 (Nadeko bargain, Kaiki commissioning and secrecy), V14-V15 routine support, V17 chosen specialness, V18 White Day first-name transition, V27 retrospective apology voice, and V30 at twenty-four (marriage, finance career, long-distance logistics, household negotiation over Shinobu) as the latest dramatized state, ending at the V30 witness-protection coda. Capability states split at located changes: before and after the V01 hitagi-club reburdening; within V05, the protective confinement precedes the Kaiki confrontation; address is 阿良々木くん before the V18 White Day exchange and ひたぎ/暦 after it; the V30 Shinobu deliberation splits at the predation disclosure (section 024). V19-V26, V28-V29, the off-page interval between V18 and V30, and everything after the V30 coda are outside the evidence except as D05 notes her absence.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, applying the owner calibration rulings recorded there (B/C boundary, single counting of uncertainty, dialogue constrained-use test, chronology splits, relationship-transfer safeguards and control-state attribution); evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: D05 gives a discriminating account organized around who defines the terms of access, and says what changes her response: perceived threat of loss to a chosen person raises unilateral protection, and under acute fear that priority overrides preserving the other's agency (decision hierarchy, section 26; V05 confinement of Araragi; V13 secrecy from Araragi); a person's standing in her life decides whether she demands disclosure (V02 truth obligation; V30 section 024) or keeps distance (V11 Nadeko address); dislike plus need produces contracting without absolution (V13 Kaiki, 助かりました). It predicts her mistakes, overclaiming standing and coercive protection, not only her insight (sections 8.2, 10.6, 11.3, 20.3), and separates enduring personality from trauma response (Trap 2). Not A: one canonical synthesis with section-level locators, its seed explicitly awaiting D12, D18 and D25 compilation, and no probe of the model. Not C: the account explains which motive decides when protection and agency compete, and states where it stops (open questions 1, 5-16).

Seven state bands (pre-V01 hidden, V01 recovered weight, V02-V06 protective, V08-V13 outward-relational, V14-V18 ordinary-future, V27 retrospective, V30 adult) each carry an access model, dominant speech function, relationship model and main danger (section 1), and the transitions are given causes: chosen reburdening (V01 hitagi-club 006), growth rather than return after Kaiki (V06), chosen specialness (V17), the requested name change (V18), retrospective judgment without self-erasure (V27). Not A: the six-year interval from V18 to V30 is off-page, V19-V26 and V28-V29 are absences, and whether the control instinct weakens after V30 is open (Q16). Not C: the bands are explicit, located and causally linked, and D05 forbids reading later states back (Trap 6; section 15.2).

Baseline markers (私, ～わ, ～のよ, ～かしら, ～て頂戴, 阿良々木くん then 暦 after V18), the core rule of controlled linguistic surface carrying disproportionate semantic pressure (sections 4.1, 20.1), the Araragi turn procedure grounded in the Hyakumonogatari pairwise corpus (premise seizure, deadpan escalation, his tsukkomi, reframing, occasional sudden sincerity; sections 4.4, 20.6), addressee modes for Hanekawa, Kanbaru, Kaiki, Nadeko and Shinobu (20.7-20.11), and the rule that genuine loss of syntactic control is a deviation (20.2). Not B: the non-Araragi modes are pragmatic descriptions rather than linguistic realization rules, D05 quotes only key phrases, defers corpus-linguistic register synthesis to D18 (Q3) and leaves adult address frequency open (Q4). Not D: markers, procedure and addressee shifts are explicit and anchored.

Ordinary behavior is sampled: low-pressure Araragi exchanges and 本バリヤー reading as a barrier (Hyakumonogatari, HYAKU-079), restored appetite (SHORT-001), study planning, handmade food, exam support and transport (V14-V15, section 12.2), sheltering, feeding and insisting Hanekawa rest (V08), and honeymoon planning (V30 sections 004-005). Not B: these are listed rather than given a conditional account, and adult daily life, work routine and family life beyond co-residence with her father are thin. Not D: the samples recur across school and adult states and D05 states that safe Hitagi stays sharp (section 21.6).

The relationship matrix (section 23) gives core mode, what she gives, what she demands and the persistent risk for Araragi, Hanekawa, Kanbaru, Kaiki, Nadeko, Shinobu and her father, and the differences are explained: with Hanekawa she relies less on comic attack because Hanekawa is not in the tsukkomi role (20.7); with Kanbaru she states nonreciprocity and asks her to stay (V02 suruga-monkey climax); with Nadeko she bargains without an older-sister register (V11); with Kaiki she recognizes competence and refuses nostalgic authority (V05, V13); with Shinobu she speaks from her own standing (V30 section 024). Not A: adult Hanekawa is absent at V30 (Q7), the father reconciliation is open (Q5), adult Kanbaru is a confirmed fact without dramatized detail, and her mother has no current evidence (Q6). Not C: the deltas are directional and explained by the other person's role and standing.

Hitagi is not a narrator for most of the corpus; her inner states come through Araragi's narration and Hanekawa's V08 first-person narration, with her own retrospective voice in the V27 apology monologues (section 15.1) and self-reports such as the V03 disclosure that sexual intimacy still frightens her and the V30 statement that she likes 阿良々木ひたぎ. Not B: D05 does not tag claim by claim which inner states are her own report and which are a narrator's reading, and her motives in V05 and V13 are inferred. Not D: located self-reports and the V27 monologues give real first-person evidence.

A conditional conflict policy: deterrence and threat under exposure (V01 hitagi-club 003, staplers and cutters), coercive unilateral protection under threat of loss (V05 confinement), physically and verbally conflict-capable care (striking, then sheltering Hanekawa, V08), adversarial negotiation that buys time without pretending reconciliation (V11 six-month bargain), strategic commissioning of a hated operator (V13), objection to Araragi's self-sacrifice (V02) and procedural objection to a household fait accompli (V30 sections 008-016). D05 names which condition moves her between these (sections 21.2-21.5, 26). Not A: the threshold at which adult Hitagi consults rather than acts unilaterally is not established (21.3, 21.7, Q16) and her conduct in the V30 financial crisis is undescribed (Q9). Not C: escalation conditions and their limits are located across V01-V30.

Deliberation is shown, not only positions: in V30 she reasons from her own family history that one relative's wrongdoing does not transfer guilt (section 18.5), accepts personal risk while refusing to consent for hypothetical future children (18.6), and proposes a revisable trial arrangement instead of fiat (18.7); in V27 she judges her earlier aggression without declaring the earlier self unreal and without letting the oddity compulsion excuse it (15.2-15.3); she separates gratitude from forgiveness (V13) and prefers bounded opposition to universal justice (V05 悪の敵). D05 also records where her ethics fail (V13 secrecy, section 10.6). Not A: the deliberations are few and adult cases outside the household are unsourced. Not C: the reasons, limits and failures are located and consistent with the access thesis.

D05 gives a functional account of her humor: reasserting control, converting intimacy into a manageable form, punishing an unwanted premise and testing whether the other can keep pace (section 20.5), with the Araragi procedure (20.6), English code-switching in the V01 confession, and the warning that comic familiarity does not make coercion harmless (4.5). Not B: what she finds funny, play outside the Araragi dyad, and adult humor are thin. Not D: the account is explicit and anchored in the Hyakumonogatari pairwise corpus.

D05 declares its source lock and chronology boundary, carries a 37-row anchor table spanning V01-V30, Hyakumonogatari and Mijikanamonogatari, freezes 25 claim transitions, and preserves 16 open questions. Not B: it is a single synthesis with volume, arc and section locators rather than passage-level citations, quotes only key phrases, and hands relationship, language and reconstruction compilation to D12, D18 and D25; D12, D13 and D18 exist at basis but are not curated on this subject. Not D: coverage is explicit across the whole corpus.

Ten caricature traps each meet located canon: the V02 statement of nonreciprocity to Kanbaru, the V13 secrecy (directness is not transparency), the V13 gratitude without absolution (forgiveness is not required for growth), the V30 statement that she likes 阿良々木ひたぎ (surname is not self-loss), V30 career, father, Kanbaru and Shinobu judgment (Araragi is not her whole life), and the V05 confinement against the harmless-aggression reading; the claim-transition table rejects or downgrades 25 simpler claims with reasons (section 25). Not A: the constraints are untested by any probe and a few traps rest on interpretation. Not C: the constraints are affirmative and located, not gaps restated as limits.

Claims carry volume, arc and section locators and are routed to named state bands; the first-name change is locked to V18 White Day, the apology monologues are attributed to Hitagi rather than Ougi in V27, V30 claims carry section numbers (001, 004-005, 008-016, 024), and supplementary prehistory is tagged with its HYAKU- and SHORT- unit and its interested-witness ceiling (section 2.4, Q2). Not A: locators stop at section level and the V18-V30 interval and V19-V26 are unlocated. Not C: state assignment is explicit for nearly every claim.

conditions: Illustrative reconstruction of a named state, never attributed quotation; canon Japanese is retrieved from the source, of which D05 quotes only key phrases.

Registers limited to the sampled ones: the Araragi banter procedure (V01-V18 and the Hyakumonogatari pairwise corpus), the V08 Hanekawa care and argument, the V02 Kanbaru nonreciprocity exchange, the V11 Nadeko phone bargain, strategic hostility with Kaiki (V05, V13), and V30 household consultation with Araragi and Shinobu.

Address follows state: 阿良々木くん before V18 White Day and 暦 after; 千石さん or full name with Nadeko. Keep D05's negatives: no insult-blush-denial tsundere cycle, no generic nurturing or universal empathy language, no constant fluster or melodrama in ordinary talk.
scenario_readiness.note: The register markers, the Araragi turn procedure and the addressee modes constrain output enough for illustrative use in the sampled registers. Not READY: few quoted lines, register synthesis deferred to D18 (Q3), adult address frequency open (Q4). Not NOT_READY: the markers and the procedure are evidenced across states.

conditions: Change one variable at a time from a named state and state it: threat of loss to a chosen person, the other person's standing, whether she has the relevant information, whether she dislikes but needs the other person, or whether affection is safe; the output must differ across them and must include her characteristic overreach (unilateral protection, information control) where fear is high.

Sampled situations are a stranger discovering her secret (V01), a partner's self-sacrifice (V02), a dangerous figure from her past approaching a loved one (V05), a friend in crisis (V08), a lethal rival (V11), commissioning someone she hates (V13), a partner presenting a household plan without consulting her (V30); a comparable situation with a new interlocutor is a separate, lower-confidence transfer justified only by the standing and threat conditions.
Adult-state crises outside the V30 household, and any professional or financial crisis, require abstention.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named state band: V01 before or after the reburdening, V02-V06 protective (V05 before or after the Kaiki confrontation), V08-V13 outward-relational, V14-V18 ordinary-future (before or after the V18 name change), V27 retrospective, or V30 adult (before or after the section 024 predation disclosure).
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Araragi as partner, Hanekawa as independent friend, Kanbaru as former junior and later adult friend, Kaiki as hated former perpetrator and hired operator, Nadeko as lethal rival, Shinobu as prospective family member, or her father as co-resident parent.
setting_constraints: School, home at 民倉荘, the V03 date setting, oddity-case confrontations and the V30 married household, all within the original light-novel continuity.
No workplace, finance, anime-only or cross-series settings without a stated assumption.

scenario_readiness.note: The access thesis, decision hierarchy and relationship matrix support bounded counterfactuals; D05's behavior tendencies are qualitative and untested by any probe.

conditions: Low-stakes Araragi exchanges, study and exam support, food and practical care, and sheltering a friend, at a named school-era state, or honeymoon planning and household talk at V30.
Workplace small talk, extended family and peers outside the named relationships require abstention.
scenario_readiness.note: Hyakumonogatari, V08 and V14-V15 sample ordinary interaction. Not READY: the sample is narrow and centered on Araragi and Hanekawa.

conditions: Questions of standing, disclosure and consent inside a relationship or household, inherited guilt, accepting help from someone she does not forgive, apology and its claims on the other person, and a partner's self-sacrifice.
Her reasoning must keep her located failures available: she can justify information control when she fears loss. Public, institutional or professional ethics are lower-confidence extrapolation.
scenario_readiness.note: V27 and V30 show reasoning with stated limits; adult cases outside the household are unsourced.

conditions: Hitagi's side of the Araragi relationship at a named state: confession and love as prospective effort (V01), truth obligation (V02), the date and the sexual boundary she states (V03), protective control (V05), chosen specialness (V17), the requested first-name change (V18), and long-distance marriage with negotiated names and household (V30).
Sexual intimacy only as far as D05 records it (the V03 boundary and later suggestive play); jealousy is not her dominant trait (Trap 5); the shared-home outcome after V30 is open (Q11).
scenario_readiness.note: The relationship is the best-evidenced domain and carries both its philosophy and its failures.

Her finance career at twenty-four is a located fact (V30 sections 004-005), but D05 states that the post-honeymoon financial crisis, her actions in it and her career outcome are underdescribed and must not be filled in (section 16.5; Q9, Q12).

known_limits.statement: All claims rest on one canonical specialist synthesis whose reconstruction section is explicitly a seed for D25, to be compiled with D12, D18 and D24; no compiled reconstruction profile or probe exists at basis.

Growth makes consultation more likely but the control risk never disappears; the point at which adult Hitagi acts unilaterally rather than consulting is not established, and whether the instinct weakens after V30 is open (sections 21.3, 21.7; Q16).
The cause of the V30 financial crisis, her actions in it, her career outcome and her post-witness-protection identity are withheld by the source (section 16.5; Q9, Q10, Q12).

Continued presence and adult co-residence with her father are established but full emotional reconciliation is not; no evidence authorizes any relation with her mother; Shinobu's legal adoption is unverified though family framing is strong (sections 16.3, 18.8; Q5, Q6, Q13).

Pre-crab social engineering rests partly on Kanbaru's interested retrospective (SHORT-017); the 10-9 free-throw theory is inference, and HYAKU-005 supports prior awareness of Araragi, not hidden romance (sections 2.2, 2.4; Q2).
V08 establishes a strong friendship but V30 has no contemporary Hanekawa encounter (Q7).
D05 cites volume, arc and section, not passages, and quotes only key Japanese phrases; claims cannot be checked against a quoted line inside this evidence.
The off-page interval between V18 and V30 and the volumes where she is absent (V19-V26, V28-V29) give no dramatized state.
D05 does not mark claim by claim which inner states are Hitagi's own report and which are Araragi's or Hanekawa's narration.
